agent.problem: The correct answer compares the master's reply in verse 23 with his reply in verse 21, but the citation includes the setup in verse 22 while omitting verse 21. Without verse 21, the citation does not cover what establishes that the two replies are word-for-word the same.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower. A choice card cites only the verses of its right answer.

agent.problem: "If the servant knew all that" relies on the preceding story card to identify which servant is meant and what "all that" refers to. The question is not self-contained once that story card is off screen.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
